queries_run: Willdan Group WLDN market share competitors 2026

findings.claim: 10-K稱市場高度分散，公司認為沒有單一對手有足夠份額影響其市場；並提示大型全國/國際工程或營建公司可能成為新進入者。
findings.excerpt: We believe that no single competitor has sufficient market share to influence the markets in which we operate.

findings.claim: 10-K風險因子：大量營收來自競標，輸標可能多年失去該市場機會，得標也可能因壓價而侵蝕利潤。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: To the extent we engage in competitive bidding and are unable to win particular contracts, we not only incur substantial costs in the bidding process that negatively affect our operating results, but we may lose the opportunity to operate in the market for the services provided under those contracts for a number of years.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋僅得聚合站(CSIMarket)的同業營收占比估計，無可逐字原文；未找到具體新進入者或設計定案搶單的獨立來源。

clues.claim: CSIMarket 估計 Willdan 占其追蹤同業群營收份額約0.2%，Q2 2026上升。
